# Catalyst screening manual

## Loading and conversion

Higher catalyst loading increases conversion between 0.5 and 2.5 mol% on Al2O3 supports.
Higher loading decreases TON at fixed conversion because more catalyst shares the same product.

## Thermal budget

The rig interlock enforces temperature + 0.1 × residence_time ≤ 150 (temperature in degC, residence_time in s).
